request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: five bold dark teal-green tiger stripes, colour #1f7a6a with #145548 shadows, across the back and three across the tail, each a thick tapering wedge running down from the spine, few and wide apart. No stripes on the head, belly or legs. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
